title: Open Kiln Loading Display
description: One static ceramics loading-display scene from the original kiln-loading program. The complete original front-loading kiln kit uses only its explicitly documented -100-degree open door pivot pose; the whole original amphora sits on its existing removable shelf at its documented full-size placement. All original local mesh POSITION/NORMAL bytes, material dictionaries, per-face assignments and node hierarchy remain intact. Only that named pose transform, whole-instance translations and one scene-only closed floor are new. One scene, zero new independent models. No continuous swing or insertion motion, actual firing, thermal/electrical function, clay suitability, load, access or safety certification.
